newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore buys three submarines from Sweden.
newsitem.headline: Singapore buys three submarines from Sweden.

text.p: Singapore has bought three second-hand submarines from Sweden for use by its navy for training, the Ministry of Defence said on Thursday.
"The submarines will be used for our crew to train on," a Defence Ministry statement said.
The three 51-metre (170-foot), Sjoormen class, diesel submarines will be delivered to the Singapore navy between August 1999 and 2001. The Ministry did not say how much Singapore was paying for them.
Each submarine has a crew of 23 officers and men. It is equipped with torpedoes, radar, weapons control and intertial navigation systems.
The Singapore navy now has one submarine, another second-hand Swedish model bought about two years ago.
